item.title: Masterson overpass halt raises safety concerns
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Construction of the P25-million pedestrian overpass on Masterson Avenue has been temporarily halted following a City Council resolution citing traffic congestion and alleged design flaws. The post Masterson overpass halt raises safety concerns appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: PPI backs creation of media-citizen council in Oro
item.description: Grievances between media practitioners and their sources are expected to be resolved more efficiently as the Philippine Press Institute (PPI) supports the creation of the 13th media-citizen council in Cagayan de Oro City. The post PPI backs creation of media-citizen council in Oro appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Explainer: What the media-citizen council means for news consumers
item.description: On Thursday, January 22, the Philippine Press Institute (PPI) convened key stakeholders to form a media-citizen council—an initiative designed to promote responsible journalism and give the public a formal platform to raise concerns about news coverage. The post Explainer: What the media-citizen council means for news consumers appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: 200 mayors rally to end classroom crisis
item.description: In a landmark “Bayanihan” summit, more than 200 mayors from across the Philippines gathered on Wednesday, January 28, to support a bold decentralization plan aimed at addressing the country’s chronic classroom shortage. The post 200 mayors rally to end classroom crisis appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: PHA eyes expansion as Basulta has no assigned cardiologists
item.description: Cardiologists of the Philippine Heart Association (PHA) are seeking to expand specialist coverage in underserved provinces, particularly in Basilan, Sulu, and Tawi-Tawi ( Basulta), where no assigned cardiologists are currently available. item.title: Iligan jail shifts from punitive to reformative care
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City Jail–Male Dormitory is shifting away from a punitive incarceration model and adopting a reformative care approach that places rehabilitation, discipline, and personal development at the center of jail management. The post Iligan jail shifts from punitive to reformative care appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: CHR supports push to decriminalize libel, cyberlibel
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY ― The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) is calling on Congress to decisively advance measures decriminalizing libel and cyberlibel, arguing that prison penalties have long been used to harass journalists and silence ordinary citizens. The post CHR supports push to decriminalize libel, cyberlibel appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.

item.title: Palace demands accountability in Basilan sinking tragedy
item.description: The national government is demanding full accountability following the sinking of the M/V Trisha Kerstin 3, one of the deadliest maritime disasters in recent years. The post Palace demands accountability in Basilan sinking tragedy appeared first on Gold Star Daily News.
